2. Ld. AR for the Revenue submits that further adjournment would not
yield any result. Accordingly, the appeal is taken up for disposal.
3. The short issue involved in the present appeal is whether the appellant
are required to discharge duty on the waste and scrap of capital goods on
which they availed CENVAT Credit at the time of its receipt.
3. Ld. AR for the Revenue submits that Rule 3(5A) of CENVAT Credit
Rules, 2004 lays down that when the capital goods after use are cleared as
waste and scrap, then the manufacturer is required to pay duty on the
transaction value of the waste and scrap of the capital goods.
4. I find that undisputedly, the appellant had cleared waste and scrap of
